title: The Diligence Engine With No Language Model In It
excerpt: A pitch deck claims 420 watt hours per kilogram, and nobody in the room can tell whether that is ambitious or physically forbidden. This one pulls the number out, finds the law that governs it, and shows the arithmetic. There is no language model anywhere near the verdict, and that is the point.

title: Dungeon Cue Is a Remote Control, Not an Audio Engine
excerpt: The mouse is on the wrong side of the table. Say the phrase and the rain starts, without breaking the scene to go clicking. It produces no sound of its own, which turns out to be the most important thing about it.

title: Shell Valley
excerpt: Grimbah invites you to save the world in the far north, at the Druid's Temple in Shell Valley.

title: The Druid's Temple in Shell Valley
excerpt: A thousand-foot sequoia rises from a silent lake. The gnome druid who hires you to enter it pays gold upfront, asks no questions, and gives you four rules. Break them and you get eaten.

title: The World of Draega & the Rivals and Destiny Campaign
excerpt: Twenty-five sessions, one archipelago, and a war between an empire that wanted everything and a rebellion that couldn't afford to lose. Digging through the bones of the Rivals and Destiny campaign — what it was, who died making it matter, and why the map still hums.

title: The Draega Chronicle [Under Excavation]
excerpt: The initial lore conversion for the Druid Temple and the world of Draega is currently being transcribed.
